author: Techno Tim
description:
What is an NPU actually useful for? Is it faster than a GPU, more efficient, or meant for a completely different kind of AI workload?

I tested the Intel NPU in the MINISFORUM MS-03 using Frigate and OpenVINO, comparing the same workload across the CPU, GPU, and NPU.

MINISFORUM sent the MS-03 for me to test and that's why you see the disclosure overlay. This video is not sponsored, they had no input into this video.

Video Notes: https://technotim.com/posts/intel-npu-frigate/
